Hi María — thanks for the docs and the quick note. Helpful. Copying Ben (Finance) and Irene (Procurement ops) to expedite setup.

Checklist & clarifications we need to activate POs for a non-US supplier in Venezuela:

1) Completed Redwood Supplier Onboarding form (link below). This is the single source for legal name, tax IDs, and remittance details.
2) VAT/exemption proof (we have your PDF) — please confirm the certificate number and the period it covers. For exempt invoices we require the certificate number printed on the face of the invoice and a short statement such as: "Sales to Redwood Inference are VAT exempt under Decree XXX."
3) Bank wiring: our preferred flow is USD to a correspondent bank (faster for payments). If you can provide the correspondent bank details (bank name, SWIFT, account number, routing), include them on the bank letter. If you only accept local transfers, flag that and provide beneficiary account + instructions.
4) Tax residency: a local equivalent of a W-8 (a signed declaration of non-US tax residency) or vendor tax residency affidavit. This speeds up withholding decisions.

Operational notes:
- PO entity: please bill to "Redwood Inference EU B.V." (we will issue the PO from that entity for LATAM suppliers unless Finance flags otherwise).
- Invoices must reference the Redwood PO number in the invoice header.
- For mixed invoices (goods + services) where part is subject to VAT and part is exempt, we prefer line-item separation on the invoice so Finance can code correctly.

Next steps: I will open a vendor record in our system pending the completed onboarding form and a translated copy of the VAT certificate. Ben — can you flag any special handling for Venezuela payments? Irene — once the onboarding form is complete we can create the first PO.
